title: Update a record and verify commit
purpose: Find exactly one record by primary key, confirm that it can be edited, apply an explicit partial update, and verify the commit result.
preconditions: The json-parameter-validation and find-one-by-primary-key pattern preconditions are satisfied.
The approved update contract distinguishes an omitted property from an explicit empty string.
Every field assignment and any before/after field map is resolved from target-solution metadata.
The account used in the selected execution context has read and edit privileges.
Any optional version field and expected value are both resolved or both omitted.

placeholders.name: TARGET_TABLE_OCCURRENCE
placeholders.resolutionSource: the resolved base table occurrence of {{TARGET_LAYOUT}}

placeholders.name: PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD
placeholders.resolutionSource: target FileMaker solution metadata and data-model contract

placeholders.name: FIELD_ASSIGNMENTS
placeholders.resolutionSource: the approved partial-update contract and target FileMaker solution metadata

steps.name: Set Error Capture
steps.purpose: Keep find, lock, field, commit, and revert failures under script control.

partialConditions.psos: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.
partialConditions.server_schedule: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.

partialConditions.psos: Do not use animation; resolve the layout explicitly because client context is not inherited.
partialConditions.server_schedule: Do not use animation; resolve the layout explicitly because no client context exists.

steps.name: Enter Find Mode
steps.purpose: Enter Find mode without an interactive pause.

partialConditions.psos: Pause must be Off because FMSE cannot provide interactive input.
partialConditions.server_schedule: Pause must be Off because FMSE cannot provide interactive input.

steps.name: Set Field
steps.purpose: Set the find criterion and then only fields explicitly present in {{FIELD_ASSIGNMENTS}}.

steps.name: Perform Find
steps.purpose: Run the primary-key find reused from find-one-by-primary-key.

steps.name: Open Record/Request
steps.purpose: Attempt to open the one matched record for editing before changing fields.

steps.name: Commit Records/Requests
steps.purpose: Commit without a dialog and expose validation, locking, and privilege failures.

partialConditions.psos: With dialog must be Off; save and validate record data explicitly.
partialConditions.server_schedule: With dialog must be Off; save and validate record data explicitly.

steps.name: Revert Record/Request
steps.purpose: Optionally discard failed uncommitted changes under a reviewed policy.

partialConditions.psos: With dialog must be Off; reverting discards all uncommitted changes in the current record.
partialConditions.server_schedule: With dialog must be Off; reverting discards all uncommitted changes in the current record.

steps.name: Set Variable
steps.purpose: Preserve errors, found count, record-open state, and approved before/after values.

steps.name: If
steps.purpose: Branch on find count, lock state, optional version, field assignment, and commit result.

steps.name: Else
steps.purpose: Separate success from conflict and failure recovery.

steps.name: Exit Script
steps.purpose: Return approved before/after data or the preserved update error.

functions.name: Get ( LastError )
functions.purpose: Preserve find, open, field, commit, and revert errors immediately.

functions.name: Get ( FoundCount )
functions.purpose: Require exactly one matching record before opening it.

functions.name: Get ( RecordOpenState )
functions.purpose: Inspect record-open state after the explicit open attempt.

functions.name: JSONSetElement
functions.purpose: Build the result with approved before/after values and conflict details.

happyPath: Validate input, then reuse find-one-by-primary-key with {{TARGET_LAYOUT}}, {{TARGET_TABLE_OCCURRENCE}}, {{PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD}}, and {{PRIMARY_KEY_VALUE_EXPRESSION}} through the exactly-one result check.
Return immediately for zero or multiple matches; never update an arbitrary record.
Open Record/Request and immediately capture Get ( LastError ), then inspect Get ( RecordOpenState ).
If {{VERSION_FIELD}} and {{EXPECTED_VERSION}} are both resolved, compare them before applying changes; otherwise omit optimistic locking explicitly.
Set only properties present in {{FIELD_ASSIGNMENTS}}; an omitted property means no change, while an explicit empty string means clear only when the contract allows it.
Commit Records/Requests with dialog Off and immediately preserve Get ( LastError ).
Return UPDATED with approved before/after values only after a zero commit error.

errorBranches.trigger: The reused find pattern produces zero matches.
errorBranches.action: Return without opening or modifying any record.

errorBranches.trigger: The reused find pattern produces multiple matches.
errorBranches.action: Return a data-integrity error and do not select a record.

errorBranches.trigger: Open Record/Request reports that the record or table is in use.
errorBranches.action: Return a conflict or apply only a bounded, idempotent retry policy.

errorBranches.trigger: {{VERSION_FIELD}} does not equal {{EXPECTED_VERSION}} or FileMaker reports a modification-ID mismatch.
errorBranches.action: Reload and let the caller resolve intent; never overwrite blindly.

errorBranches.trigger: The account cannot read, open, or edit the record or a target field.
errorBranches.action: Return an authorization failure without exposing protected values.
Stop further assignments and follow the reviewed revert policy.
Return a validation result; do not expose sensitive before-values.

errorBranches.trigger: The record was modified by another user before commit.
errorBranches.action: Return a conflict and require the caller to reload and re-evaluate.

errorBranches.trigger: Commit returns any other nonzero result.
errorBranches.action: Preserve the error, report that changes may remain uncommitted, and apply only the reviewed revert policy.

concurrencyNotes: PSOS and schedules can update the same record concurrently; opening a record and checking commit are both required.
Optimistic locking is optional only when the target solution lacks an approved version field; never invent {{VERSION_FIELD}}.
A retry is safe only when the request is idempotent and the entire update intent is re-read and re-evaluated.
The before-value snapshot can become stale; it is an audit/result aid, not a lock.
securityNotes: Verify record and field privileges before reading before-values or applying changes.
Limit {{OUTPUT_FIELD_MAP}} to values approved for the caller.
Revert Record/Request discards all uncommitted changes in the record and requires an explicit policy.
Do not log sensitive old or new values merely to diagnose a conflict.
